body:
[A10] Assignment for #82 (author [A649]). Branch `82-boot-gm-thisclock` from main.

1. From reset, publish thisClock as grandmaster and {thisClock} as the path, before any peer: IEEE 802.1AS-2020 10.3.13.2.4 b) and i).
   - When a better grandmaster appears, normal BMCA publication takes over.
   - When it leaves, the instance returns to thisClock.
2. Keep the published-interface contract that milan-fpga consumes (`hdl/milan/milan_datapath.sv:1515`) unchanged in width and timing. Add a simulation case for each:
   - the boot state with no peer;
   - a peer that wins;
   - a peer that leaves.

   Each case gets a planted mutant.
3. Run this repository's gates. Run the milan-fpga consumer gates on a scratch parent at dev e9cbb676, with the gptp-processor gitlink set to your head.
4. STOP on any interface or parameter change seen by the parent.

Post REVIEW READY or STOP here.
